title: Data centers and grid: points premium, all-time base
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Stories about data centers and grid earn more points than the average story of the same months, across 2006 to 2026.
expect: Points per matching story against the average story of the same months, all months: at least 1.3x strongly supports, at least 1.1x weakly supports; at or below 0.9x refutes. Between is inconclusive.

check.per_label: points per story against the same-month average

group_a.label: data centers and grid stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: Average story of the same months ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: HN attention is not technical validation, adoption, revenue or investment return.
Title matching only; some titles about the theme will be missed and some matches will be false. Archive scores for 2025-26 stories are low for all stories, so the points cards use ratios.
Solar matches panels, power, energy, cells and photovoltaics, not eclipses or the solar system.
